visual_review.notes: H3 video. Several takes fired the sprayer where nothing should come out: the first idle puffs spores, the attack jab releases a white puff, the ranged shot shows the mist cone and the defend guard sprays at the end. A retaken idle that said never to squeeze the grip still sprayed and its hit retake sprayed a water jet, so the hit was retaken a third time, guided by all three painted hit poses, and comes back clean. The idle loops on the puff-free stretch from frame 106 through the wrap to frame 12. The attack skips the puff frames and snaps to full reach, the ranged shot skips the visible mist and holds the aim, the hit ends once she is back in stance, and the defend holds the crouch before the spray starts. The walk loops on frames 36 to 96.
